transport: authenticated Web Host RPC, SQLite, isolated empty restore destination

web.command: vitest run --config vitest.web.config.ts apps/web/tests/taskboard.e2e.ts -t 'reads successive task activity|recovers missed Taskboard activity|reopens SQLite|limits named team members'

host.command: vitest run packages/api/taskboard-controller/tests/taskboard.host.spec.ts -t 'notifies an active Taskboard stream|keeps the greatest bound Session position|commits requirements and activity|binds human acceptance|serializes membership changes'

cases: Incremental pages match detail history, including interleaved append and replayed comment
Empty page retains the last checkpoint; a subsequent Run is returned once with its Run ID
A restarted Host reproduces the same historical page
Restoring the backup appends a cancellation for the queued Run, readable from the pre-restore checkpoint
Other-project reads yield null; cross-task, displaced and unknown command checkpoints are rejected
